column3: The exception journal source is now produced (W5a P-exception, ExceptionStore.record): one event per captured exception with BootUI ExceptionPayload fields (groupId, exceptionClass, signature, types, logged); the kind itself is not implemented; deviations: envelope executionId and threadKind absent; signature hashes the class and the first application (else innermost) frame, not BootUI's top frames; marks not carried; requestId only for this install's requests; types walk the exception's own chain (root plus 8 causes, ExceptionStore.MAX_CAUSE_DEPTH), each link __cause__ or else an unsuppressed __context__ as Python's traceback shows it (BootUI follows getCause only), and, for an exception group, only the first leaf's chain (BootUI has no groups), the same depth as the panel's causes list (8, as BootUI; owner ruling 2026-11-12); failedOrSlow is true as in BootUI
The exception journal source (exceptionClass, requestId) is now produced; the kind itself is not implemented
